title: ID0425446-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S0 170004036] Update the charger to the latest FW.
description: Reported behavior/issue:  It is again not possible to perform an update. The download of FW 5... was started last week. It is still not possible to install the update. What is the reason? Is there any way I can solve this myself in the future? The update problem is now standard. Please update the charger to the latest FW.
